workedExamples.prompt: Compare “phone” and “when”. What should a reader notice?
workedExamples.solution: ph represents /f/ in phone; wh is commonly pronounced /w/ in when.

workedExamples.prompt: A learner substitutes f for ph in spelling phone. What should be checked?
workedExamples.solution: Compare the complete word with conventional spelling and practise ph in phone.
